_comment: Offer math placeholders. THESE NUMBERS ARE NOT YOUR NUMBERS YET.
arvMultiplier scales the published value to a market ARV. Assessor values
often lag the market, so a county where assessments run 15 percent light
would use 1.15. Check it against a handful of recent sales you know.
Nothing in this system sends an offer, so a wrong number here shows up as a
wrong number on a review screen, not as a contract.
leaseOption is the rent to own structure: an option fee, monthly rent, a
strike price, and a share of each rent payment credited toward the purchase.
It transfers no title, so a due on sale clause has nothing to catch.
